notes.title: Join the Community!
notes.notes:
Good day, explorers!

I'd like to invite you to join our community on our Discord server!
[url=https://discord.gg/NTCq2fY][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41944861/4134543dc4b96be4c11765a5f855ca37c3037ebc.png[/img][/url]
Dragon Emperors Discord server is our Discord server that consists mainly of news about our games and the community around them. We also talk about our favorite topic, RPG games! So, if you like our games or RPG games come join us!

Also, if you streamed or recorded your gameplay, share them with the community! We have a channel for that in our Discord server. I'm definitely looking forward to them!

Thank you for your support and stay tuned for future updates!

notes.title: Three Mazeketeers is Joining The Nightmarket Festival 2022!
notes.notes:
Three Mazeketeers is participating in The Nightmarket Festival 2022!
The Nightmarket Festival 2022 is showcasing around 100 discounted games, and offering free demos for dozens of hot upcoming titles!
The sale runs from Aug 5-9 at 1 am GMT+7. And includes live broadcasts to celebrate and showcase the lineup.
The Nightmarket Festival 2022 is the first-ever Steam sales event focusing on promoting games from the SEA region, breaking cultural barriers, and raising awareness for the region’s gaming scene. We introduce awesome games with a local touch, just like the night market culture commonly seen here -- filled with creativity, diversity, and great fun.
[h2]The Nightmarket Festival Live Show Program[/h2]
[h3]Aug 6 14:00 - 22:30 GMT+7 (in Mandarin)[/h3]
[b]Featured games[/b]: OPUS: Echo of Starsong - Full Bloom Edition, My Lovely Wife, Alina of the Arena, Potion Permit, SIMULACRA 3, Minds Beneath Us
[h3]Aug 7 14:00 - 15:30 GMT+7 (in English)[/h3]
[b]Featured games[/b]: Asterigos: Curse of the Stars, Dusk Diver 2, Nine Sols, Dungeon Munchies, The Legend of Tianding
Get your wallet ready and enjoy a diverse taste of unique SEA games waiting for you to check out! Forget the scorching weather, the party’s indoors! We got your weekend covered!
